description: 2008 global food/rice crisis; export restrictions, panic buying, hoarding
2010 super-floods: multi-crop supply shock (wheat stocks, cotton, sugarcane, rice)
2022 catastrophic nationwide floods; major multi-crop supply shock
IMF Extended Fund Facility (EFF) begins; drove later MSP abolition + deregulation
ECC banned wheat+flour export (fine flour 2019-10-25; suji/maida 2019-11-01); kept in place during shortage
Punjab banned wheat movement to Sindh; Karachi prices +30%
Punjab restricted wheat/flour supply to KP (officially denied); inter-provincial friction
ECC banned wheat export amid shortage
Duties/taxes waived; private-sector wheat imports allowed (no time limit)
MSP set Rs1600/40kg
MSP Rs3900/40kg for 2023 crop
Large govt/private wheat imports (~3.5M t) -> market glut, prices fell, farmers hurt
Caretaker ECC bans state-level wheat import (reserves sufficient, flour prices stable)
Federal govt bans BOTH import and export of wheat/flour/refined flour/semolina
MSP abolished under IMF 2023 EFF condition; market deregulation begins; prices fell ~35% YoY
Govt backtracked; MSP reinstated Rs3500/40kg with 6.2M t procurement commitment
Wheat price deregulation legislated under IMF (tariff cuts, end of admin prices)
Sugar export ban imposed (shortage)
ECC allowed 100k t export (2022-12-15), raised to 250k t (2023-01-17); domestic price ~doubled Rs85->Rs165
Export ban reaffirmed/in place after price surge
2024/25 export quota (~700k t) allowed; halted Mar 2025 (no further exports)
Govt approved sugar imports; IMF criticized the import policy
Cane/sugar support price ended -> 2025 production fell
Full sugar-sector deregulation by June 2026: end admin cane/sugar prices, zoning, licensing; phased import/export liberalization
2008 global rice crisis; export curbs
Minimum export price set: $1300/t basmati, $550/t non-basmati
MEP withdrawn for all rice (after India removed its MEP); export rebate revised, price cap removed
Cotton intervention/support price set for 2022-23 crop
ECC set cotton intervention price Rs8500/40kg for 2023-24 crop
EFS amended: imported raw cotton/yarn/fabric GST-exempt (favors imports over local cotton)
Regulatory duty on maize imports imposed (date approx)
Maize exports surged (~400k t 2023/24); poultry sector lobbying for export curbs
